verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance documents a dedicated Sandbox project on the non-billable, unlimited Test Drive plan, with access to all API endpoints. Testing runs against test banks (FinBanks), a test payroll provider (FinPayroll) and testing personas instead of real customer accounts, so the product itself provides a sandbox separate from production. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that sandbox data is isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A Sandbox project gives you access to the Open Finance Test Drive plan. Test Drive is a non-billable, unlimited plan that provides access to all Open Finance API endpoints.
you will learn how to use our test banks (FinBanks) and test payroll provider (FinPayroll). You will get access to a wide variety of profiles and data to test different types of use case scenarios.
we provide you with a set of testing personas. Each persona represents an example of a user who might use your app.
